selected_evidence.summary: useradd -m datauser succeeded; id datauser shows uid=1000(datauser)

selected_evidence.requirement: /srv/data quota is enforced by the filesystem itself (not app-level)
selected_evidence.summary: Built dedicated XFS loopback filesystem, persisted in fstab with uquota option, mounted, and set XFS user quota bsoft=bhard=100M for datauser via xfs_quota
150MB write as datauser truncated at exactly 100MB with 'Disk quota exceeded'; separate 10MB write under the limit succeeded and quota report reflected usage
Captured boot_id 34027437-307c-4f58-bdb2-1fe626bb2d66, confirmed /srv/data mounted with usrquota, data present, and quota report showing 10M/100M
systemctl reboot dispatched in background; command returned pid before the node disconnected

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 boot identity changed after restart
selected_evidence.summary: Node was unreachable during reboot (connection timeouts), then reconnected with new boot_id 8e10fe6f-7eb2-4f9d-a94d-4f9a64233ef5, differing from the pre-restart boot_id

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of quota-enforced filesystem and data
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, /srv/data auto-remounted via fstab with usrquota, prior file (small.bin) intact, quota report unchanged, and over-limit write again failed with 'Disk quota exceeded' confirming enforcement survived the restart
